397410951ddc259e.es: LangChain is a Python framework for developing applications powered by language models. Its purpose is to create context-aware reasoning applications by chaining multiple components together. Core capabilities include prompt templating, memory management, and agent-based reasoning. Strengths include extensive integration with major LLM providers like OpenAI and Anthropic, modular architecture, and comprehensive documentation. Typical use cases include chatbots, question-answering systems, document analysis, and automated workflow applications that require sequential reasoning and context preservation.

2e943991bc527b38.en: D3.js is a JavaScript library for creating dynamic, interactive data visualizations in web browsers. Its core capability is binding data to DOM elements, enabling manipulation based on datasets. Key strengths include powerful data transformation methods, extensive visualization components, and support for SVG, Canvas, and HTML. It provides fine-grained control over visual representations without predefined chart templates. Typical use cases include custom interactive charts, complex data dashboards, geographic visualizations, network diagrams, and real-time data displays where standard charting libraries are insufficient.
2e943991bc527b38.zh: D3.js是一个用于在Web浏览器中创建动态交互式数据可视化的JavaScript库。其核心能力是将数据绑定到DOM元素，实现基于数据集的动态操作。主要优势包括强大的数据转换方法、丰富的可视化组件以及对SVG、Canvas和HTML的支持。它提供对视觉表示的精细控制，无需预定义的图表模板。典型应用场景包括自定义交互式图表、复杂数据仪表板、地理可视化、网络关系图以及实时数据显示，特别适用于标准图表库无法满足需求的复杂可视化项目。
2e943991bc527b38.es: D3.js is a JavaScript library for creating dynamic, interactive data visualizations in web browsers. Its core capability is binding data to DOM elements, enabling manipulation based on datasets. Key strengths include powerful data transformation methods, extensive visualization components, and support for SVG, Canvas, and HTML. It provides fine-grained control over visual representations without predefined chart templates. Typical use cases include custom interactive charts, complex data dashboards, geographic visualizations, network diagrams, and real-time data displays where standard charting libraries are insufficient.

0027d8be874e0370.en: Three.js is a cross-browser JavaScript library and API for creating and displaying animated 3D computer graphics in web browsers. It uses WebGL, WebGPU, SVG, and CSS3D renderers without requiring browser plugins. Core capabilities include scene graph management, materials, lighting, cameras, geometries, and animation systems. Strengths include extensive documentation, large community support, and performance optimization. Typical use cases span data visualization, product configurators, architectural walkthroughs, educational simulations, gaming, and virtual/augmented reality experiences.
0027d8be874e0370.zh: Three.js 是一个跨浏览器的 JavaScript 库和 API，用于在网页浏览器中创建和展示动画 3D 计算机图形。它利用 WebGL、WebGPU、SVG 和 CSS3D 渲染器，无需浏览器插件。核心功能包括场景图管理、材质、光照、相机、几何体和动画系统。优势在于详尽的文档、庞大的社区支持和性能优化。典型应用场景涵盖数据可视化、产品配置器、建筑漫游、教育模拟、游戏开发以及虚拟/增强现实体验，广泛应用于交互式 3D 内容展示。
0027d8be874e0370.es: Three.js is a cross-browser JavaScript library and API for creating and displaying animated 3D computer graphics in web browsers. It uses WebGL, WebGPU, SVG, and CSS3D renderers without requiring browser plugins. Core capabilities include scene graph management, materials, lighting, cameras, geometries, and animation systems. Strengths include extensive documentation, large community support, and performance optimization. Typical use cases span data visualization, product configurators, architectural walkthroughs, educational simulations, gaming, and virtual/augmented reality experiences.

8e8225cb890b1f7e.en: Axios is a promise-based HTTP client library for JavaScript, designed to work in both browser and Node.js environments. Its core purpose is to simplify HTTP requests by providing a clean, intuitive API. Key capabilities include making GET, POST, PUT, DELETE requests, handling request/response interception, automatic JSON data transformation, and cancellation. Strengths include excellent browser compatibility, consistent API across environments, and comprehensive error handling. Typical use cases involve fetching data from REST APIs, submitting form data, and building web applications requiring HTTP communication.
8e8225cb890b1f7e.zh: Axios是一个基于Promise的HTTP客户端库，专为浏览器和Node.js环境设计。其核心目的是通过提供简洁直观的API来简化HTTP请求处理。主要功能包括发起GET、POST、PUT、DELETE等HTTP请求，支持请求和响应拦截器，自动进行JSON数据转换，以及请求取消功能。该库的优势在于出色的浏览器兼容性、跨环境一致的API接口以及完善的错误处理机制。典型应用场景包括从REST API获取数据、提交表单数据，以及构建需要HTTP通信的Web应用程序。
8e8225cb890b1f7e.es: Axios is a promise-based HTTP client library for JavaScript, designed to work in both browser and Node.js environments. Its core purpose is to simplify HTTP requests by providing a clean, intuitive API. Key capabilities include making GET, POST, PUT, DELETE requests, handling request/response interception, automatic JSON data transformation, and cancellation. Strengths include excellent browser compatibility, consistent API across environments, and comprehensive error handling. Typical use cases involve fetching data from REST APIs, submitting form data, and building web applications requiring HTTP communication.

d864ec7ae47e7dc3.en: Excalidraw is an open-source virtual whiteboard application designed for creating hand-drawn style diagrams and sketches. Its core capabilities include real-time collaboration, allowing multiple users to edit simultaneously. The platform features an intuitive interface with drawing tools, shapes, text, and freehand sketching. Key strengths are its simplicity, end-to-end encryption for privacy, and export options to various formats. Typical use cases include technical diagramming, brainstorming sessions, team meetings, educational illustrations, and wireframing, serving both individual and collaborative design needs.
d864ec7ae47e7dc3.zh: Excalidraw 是一款开源的虚拟白板应用，专为创建手绘风格图表和草图而设计。其核心功能包括实时协作，允许多用户同时编辑。该平台具有直观的界面，提供绘图工具、形状、文本和自由手绘功能。主要优势在于其简洁性、端到端加密确保隐私以及多种格式导出选项。典型应用场景涵盖技术图表绘制、头脑风暴会议、团队讨论、教育图解和线框图设计，满足个人和协作设计需求。
d864ec7ae47e7dc3.es: Excalidraw is an open-source virtual whiteboard application designed for creating hand-drawn style diagrams and sketches. Its core capabilities include real-time collaboration, allowing multiple users to edit simultaneously. The platform features an intuitive interface with drawing tools, shapes, text, and freehand sketching. Key strengths are its simplicity, end-to-end encryption for privacy, and export options to various formats. Typical use cases include technical diagramming, brainstorming sessions, team meetings, educational illustrations, and wireframing, serving both individual and collaborative design needs.

716fa020248e4dc4.en: TypeScript is a statically typed superset of JavaScript that compiles to plain JavaScript. Its primary purpose is to add optional static typing and modern language features to JavaScript development. Core capabilities include type checking, interfaces, generics, and advanced tooling support. Key strengths are enhanced code reliability, better developer experience with intelligent code completion, and seamless integration with existing JavaScript ecosystems. Typical use cases include large-scale web applications, enterprise software development, and projects requiring maintainable codebases with robust type safety.
716fa020248e4dc4.zh: TypeScript 是 JavaScript 的静态类型超集，可编译为纯 JavaScript。其主要目的是为 JavaScript 开发添加可选的静态类型和现代语言特性。核心功能包括类型检查、接口、泛型和高级工具支持。关键优势在于提升代码可靠性、通过智能代码补全改善开发者体验，以及与现有 JavaScript 生态系统的无缝集成。典型应用场景包括大规模 Web 应用程序、企业软件开发，以及需要可维护代码库和强类型安全性的项目。TypeScript 特别适用于团队协作和长期维护的大型项目，帮助在开发阶段捕获类型错误。
716fa020248e4dc4.es: TypeScript is a statically typed superset of JavaScript that compiles to plain JavaScript. Its primary purpose is to add optional static typing and modern language features to JavaScript development. Core capabilities include type checking, interfaces, generics, and advanced tooling support. Key strengths are enhanced code reliability, better developer experience with intelligent code completion, and seamless integration with existing JavaScript ecosystems. Typical use cases include large-scale web applications, enterprise software development, and projects requiring maintainable codebases with robust type safety.

6bd67722481c0094.en: Deno is a modern JavaScript and TypeScript runtime built with Rust, designed to provide a secure and productive development environment. It features built-in TypeScript support without additional configuration, a secure-by-default execution model that restricts file, network, and environment access unless explicitly permitted, and a decentralized package management system using URL imports. Core capabilities include a comprehensive standard library, top-level await support, and built-in testing and formatting tools. Deno is particularly strong for building web servers, command-line tools, and scripts requiring high security and modern JavaScript features.
6bd67722481c0094.zh: Deno 是一个使用 Rust 构建的现代 JavaScript 和 TypeScript 运行时，旨在提供安全高效的开发环境。其核心特性包括原生支持 TypeScript 无需额外配置、默认安全执行模式限制文件、网络和环境访问权限、基于 URL 导入的分散式包管理系统。Deno 具备完整的标准库、顶层 await 支持、内置测试和代码格式化工具等核心能力。主要优势在于安全性、现代化工具链和简化的工作流程。典型应用场景包括构建 Web 服务器、开发命令行工具、编写需要高安全性的脚本，以及需要现代 JavaScript 特性的各种应用开发。
6bd67722481c0094.es: Deno is a modern JavaScript and TypeScript runtime built with Rust, designed to provide a secure and productive development environment. It features built-in TypeScript support without additional configuration, a secure-by-default execution model that restricts file, network, and environment access unless explicitly permitted, and a decentralized package management system using URL imports. Core capabilities include a comprehensive standard library, top-level await support, and built-in testing and formatting tools. Deno is particularly strong for building web servers, command-line tools, and scripts requiring high security and modern JavaScript features.

581379420c079996.en: Node.js Best Practices is a comprehensive collection of guidelines for developing Node.js applications. It covers architectural patterns, security measures, performance optimization, testing strategies, and error handling. The project provides actionable recommendations for production-ready applications, including code organization, dependency management, and deployment practices. It serves as a reference for developers building scalable and maintainable Node.js systems across various domains like web services, APIs, and microservices.
581379420c079996.zh: Node.js最佳实践项目是一个全面的Node.js应用开发指南集合。该项目系统整理了Node.js开发中的架构模式、安全防护措施、性能优化方案、测试策略和错误处理机制。内容涵盖代码组织规范、依赖管理、部署实践等生产环境关键要素，为开发者提供可操作的技术建议。适用于构建Web服务、API接口和微服务等各类Node.js应用场景，帮助开发团队创建可扩展且易于维护的系统架构。该项目通过实际案例和具体代码示例，指导开发者遵循行业最佳实践。
581379420c079996.es: Node.js Best Practices is a comprehensive collection of guidelines for developing Node.js applications. It covers architectural patterns, security measures, performance optimization, testing strategies, and error handling. The project provides actionable recommendations for production-ready applications, including code organization, dependency management, and deployment practices. It serves as a reference for developers building scalable and maintainable Node.js systems across various domains like web services, APIs, and microservices.

0c9d6aa23bdabfac.en: Create React App is a zero-configuration build tool for React applications. Its primary purpose is to quickly set up modern React projects with minimal setup. Core capabilities include pre-configured build pipelines, development servers, and testing environments. Key strengths are its simplicity, official React team support, and comprehensive feature set out of the box. Typical use cases include starting new React projects, learning React development, and creating prototypes where complex configuration isn't required.
0c9d6aa23bdabfac.zh: Create React App 是一个零配置的 React 应用程序构建工具，其主要目的是通过最小化设置快速搭建现代化的 React 项目。核心功能包括预配置的构建管道、开发服务器和测试环境。主要优势在于其简单易用性、React 官方团队支持以及开箱即用的全面功能集。典型使用场景包括启动新的 React 项目、学习 React 开发以及创建不需要复杂配置的原型应用。该工具特别适合初学者和需要快速启动项目的开发者。

Core capabilities include pre-configured build pipelines, development servers, and testing environments. ad784def4941f8a3.en: frp is a fast reverse proxy written in Go that enables exposing local servers behind NAT or firewalls to the internet. It supports TCP, UDP, HTTP, and HTTPS protocols for secure tunneling. Core capabilities include port forwarding, load balancing, and P2P connectivity. Strengths are its high performance, cross-platform compatibility, and simple configuration. Typical use cases include accessing home servers, remote desktop connections, and deploying local web services publicly without complex network setup.

c298733a5252eb28.en: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application designed as a self-hosted alternative to commercial solutions like TeamViewer. Built primarily with Rust, it enables secure peer-to-peer connections for remote control across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. Core capabilities include screen sharing, file transfer, and clipboard synchronization. Its strengths lie in privacy-focused self-hosting options, cross-platform compatibility, and no mandatory cloud dependency. Typical use cases include IT support, remote work collaboration, and personal device access.

Key strengths are its comprehensive feature set, strong typing through TypeScript, excellent tooling support, and enterprise-grade scalability. 8ed84aed106b8236.en: Tauri is a framework for building desktop and mobile applications using web technologies. It creates native apps by embedding a system webview to render HTML/CSS/JavaScript frontends, while the application logic runs in a Rust backend. Key strengths include small bundle sizes, high performance, and strong security compared to similar tools. It supports cross-platform development for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS. Typical use cases include creating lightweight desktop utilities, business applications, and mobile apps where web development skills can be leveraged for native deployment.

Core capabilities include DOM manipulation, form submission, keyboard/mouse simulation, and network request interception. d2d386241891abab.en: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework designed for rapid UI development. It provides low-level utility classes that can be composed to build custom designs directly in HTML markup. Core capabilities include responsive design utilities, hover/focus states, and extensive customization options. Strengths include faster development cycles, consistent design systems, and reduced CSS bloat. Typical use cases include building modern web applications, prototyping interfaces, and maintaining scalable design systems across development teams.

731cfc310cb7dad1.en: FastAPI is a modern Python web framework for building APIs with automatic OpenAPI and JSON Schema generation. It leverages Python type hints for data validation, serialization, and documentation. Built on Starlette and Pydantic, it offers high performance with async support. Core capabilities include automatic interactive API documentation, dependency injection, and standards-based design. Strengths include developer productivity, type safety, and production readiness. Typical use cases range from internal microservices to public REST APIs requiring robust documentation and validation.

4704039896cf0d7b.en: Supabase is an open-source development platform providing a dedicated PostgreSQL database for building web, mobile, and AI applications. It offers real-time capabilities through websockets, built-in authentication with OAuth2 support, and vector embeddings via pgvector for AI workloads. Core strengths include being a Firebase alternative with full PostgreSQL functionality, automatic API generation, and extensive tooling. Typical use cases include real-time applications, AI-powered services with vector search, and full-stack development with Next.js integration.

da5cb87ad92fc40f.en: Whisper is an open-source speech recognition system developed by OpenAI, designed to transcribe spoken language into text with high accuracy across diverse conditions. Its core capabilities include multilingual transcription, translation into English, and handling various accents and audio qualities. Strengths lie in robustness to background noise and technical artifacts, achieved through large-scale weak supervision training on diverse audio data. Typical use cases encompass transcription services, accessibility tools, media analysis, and applications requiring automated speech-to-text conversion without extensive customization.

Core capabilities include interactive component development, visual testing, and comprehensive documentation generation. Its strengths lie in supporting design systems, facilitating team collaboration, and improving component quality through isolated development environments. b5916a9db6dc577c.en: v2rayN is a GUI client for Windows, Linux, and macOS that supports multiple proxy protocols including V2Ray, Xray, sing-box, Shadowsocks, Trojan, VMess, and VLESS. It provides user-friendly configuration and management of proxy connections with features like server switching, traffic statistics, and rule-based routing. The software enables bypassing network restrictions and accessing blocked content through encrypted tunnels. Typical use cases include circumventing censorship, enhancing privacy, and accessing geo-restricted services.
b5916a9db6dc577c.zh: v2rayN 是一款适用于 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 的图形界面客户端，支持 V2Ray、Xray、sing-box、Shadowsocks、Trojan、VMess、VLESS 等多种代理协议。该软件提供直观的代理连接配置和管理功能，包括服务器切换、流量统计和基于规则的路由设置。通过建立加密隧道，v2rayN 能够绕过网络限制，访问被屏蔽的内容。典型应用场景包括突破网络审查、增强隐私保护以及访问地域限制的服务，为用户提供灵活可靠的网络代理解决方案。

dfd225d129632b54.en: nvm is a POSIX-compliant bash script that manages multiple Node.js versions on Unix-like systems. It enables easy installation, switching between versions, and setting default versions. Core capabilities include installing specific Node versions, managing LTS releases, and automatic version switching using .nvmrc files. Strengths include shell integration, fast operations, and compatibility with bash and zsh. Typical use cases involve development environments requiring different Node versions, CI/CD pipelines, and testing applications across multiple Node releases.
dfd225d129632b54.zh: nvm 是一个符合 POSIX 标准的 bash 脚本，用于在类 Unix 系统上管理多个 Node.js 版本。它支持轻松安装不同版本、切换当前使用的版本以及设置默认版本。核心功能包括安装特定 Node 版本、管理长期支持（LTS）版本，以及通过 .nvmrc 文件自动切换版本。其优势在于与 shell 的深度集成、操作速度快，且兼容 bash 和 zsh 等 shell。典型应用场景包括需要不同 Node 版本的开发环境、持续集成/持续部署（CI/CD）流水线，以及跨多个 Node 版本测试应用程序的兼容性。

8d0809006c655ead.en: Coding Interview University is a comprehensive computer science study plan designed to prepare individuals for software engineering interviews. It covers essential topics including algorithms, data structures, and programming interview techniques. The project provides structured learning materials and practice exercises to build foundational knowledge required for technical interviews at major technology companies. With over 330,000 GitHub stars, it serves as a popular self-study resource for aspiring software engineers.
8d0809006c655ead.zh: Coding Interview University 是一个完整的计算机科学学习计划，旨在帮助个人准备软件工程面试。该项目涵盖了算法、数据结构、编程面试技巧等核心内容，提供结构化的学习材料和练习题目，帮助建立技术面试所需的基础知识。该资源特别针对大型科技公司的面试要求设计，在GitHub上获得超过33万星标，成为求职者广泛使用的自学工具。学习计划包括计算机科学基础、系统设计、编程语言实践等多个模块，通过系统化学习路径提升面试竞争力。

The project provides structured learning materials and practice exercises to build foundational knowledge required for technical interviews at major technology companies. With over 330,000 GitHub stars, it serves as a popular self-study resource for aspiring software engineers.

de8862daf1ed73fc.en: React is a JavaScript library developed by Facebook for building user interfaces for web and native applications. It follows a declarative programming paradigm and component-based architecture, enabling developers to create reusable UI components. The library efficiently manages application state and updates the user interface through its virtual DOM implementation. React supports both web applications and mobile development through React Native, providing a consistent development experience across different platforms.
de8862daf1ed73fc.zh: React是由Facebook开发的JavaScript库，用于构建Web和原生应用程序的用户界面。该库采用声明式编程范式和基于组件的架构，允许开发者创建可重用的UI组件。React通过虚拟DOM实现高效的状态管理和界面更新，优化了应用程序性能。该库支持Web应用开发，同时通过React Native扩展支持移动端开发，为不同平台提供一致的开发体验。React的组件化设计模式促进了代码的可维护性和团队协作，成为现代前端开发的主流选择之一。
de8862daf1ed73fc.es: React is a JavaScript library developed by Facebook for building user interfaces for web and native applications. It follows a declarative programming paradigm and component-based architecture, enabling developers to create reusable UI components. The library efficiently manages application state and updates the user interface through its virtual DOM implementation. React supports both web applications and mobile development through React Native, providing a consistent development experience across different platforms.

2e9897860d4dbb1d.en: Vue.js is a progressive JavaScript framework for building user interfaces. This repository contains Vue 2, which features an approachable core library focused on the view layer only. It uses a component-based architecture and declarative rendering with a virtual DOM. Vue 2 provides reactive data binding and composable components, enabling developers to create sophisticated single-page applications. The framework emphasizes simplicity and flexibility in web development.
2e9897860d4dbb1d.zh: Vue.js 是一个用于构建用户界面的渐进式 JavaScript 框架。此仓库包含 Vue 2 版本，该版本采用易于理解的核心库，专注于视图层。它使用基于组件的架构和带有虚拟 DOM 的声明式渲染。Vue 2 提供响应式数据绑定和可组合组件，使开发人员能够创建复杂的单页面应用程序。该框架强调在 Web 开发中的简单性和灵活性，支持逐步采用和与其他库的集成。
2e9897860d4dbb1d.es: Vue.js is a progressive JavaScript framework for building user interfaces. This repository contains Vue 2, which features an approachable core library focused on the view layer only. It uses a component-based architecture and declarative rendering with a virtual DOM. Vue 2 provides reactive data binding and composable components, enabling developers to create sophisticated single-page applications. The framework emphasizes simplicity and flexibility in web development.

dfbf2bd0b460fc6e.en: The Algorithms - Python is a comprehensive collection of algorithm implementations written in Python. It covers fundamental computer science algorithms including sorting methods, search techniques, graph algorithms, and mathematical computations. The project serves as an educational resource for students and developers learning algorithm concepts. All implementations are community-contributed and designed for clarity and educational purposes rather than production optimization. The repository includes various algorithm categories with practical code examples.
dfbf2bd0b460fc6e.zh: The Algorithms - Python 是一个用 Python 编写的全面算法实现集合。它涵盖基础计算机科学算法，包括排序方法、搜索技术、图算法和数学计算。该项目作为学生和开发人员学习算法概念的教育资源。所有实现均由社区贡献，旨在提供清晰易懂的代码示例用于教育目的而非生产环境优化。该仓库包含多种算法类别，如动态规划、数据结构操作和数值方法，为算法学习和面试准备提供实用参考。
dfbf2bd0b460fc6e.es: The Algorithms - Python is a comprehensive collection of algorithm implementations written in Python. It covers fundamental computer science algorithms including sorting methods, search techniques, graph algorithms, and mathematical computations. All implementations are community-contributed and designed for clarity and educational purposes rather than production optimization. The repository includes various algorithm categories with practical code examples.

0b4f1fe6b1d47535.en: The OSSU Computer Science project provides a comprehensive curriculum for self-taught computer science education using free online courses. It covers fundamental topics including programming, algorithms, data structures, computer architecture, mathematics, and specialized areas. The curriculum is structured as a complete path from beginner to advanced levels, utilizing high-quality open educational resources. It serves as a guide for individuals seeking systematic computer science education without formal university enrollment.
0b4f1fe6b1d47535.zh: OSSU计算机科学项目提供完整的自学计算机科学课程体系，使用免费在线课程资源。该课程涵盖编程基础、算法与数据结构、计算机体系结构、数学基础及专业领域知识。课程结构从初级到高级系统编排，整合优质开放教育资源。项目为希望系统学习计算机科学但未进入正规大学的学生提供完整学习路径指南，包含课程选择顺序和学习建议。

It serves as a guide for individuals seeking systematic computer science education without formal university enrollment.

69724769af1a5476.en: JavaScript Algorithms repository contains implementations of various algorithms and data structures in JavaScript programming language. It includes detailed explanations, code examples, and references to additional learning materials. The project covers fundamental computer science concepts such as sorting algorithms, search methods, graph algorithms, and common data structures. It serves as both educational resource for learning algorithms and practical reference for technical interview preparation and software development.
69724769af1a5476.zh: JavaScript算法仓库包含多种算法和数据结构的JavaScript实现，提供详细解释、代码示例和相关学习资料链接。项目涵盖计算机科学核心概念，包括排序算法、搜索方法、图算法及常用数据结构。该资源既可作为算法学习的教育材料，也可作为技术面试准备和软件开发的实际参考工具，帮助开发者理解和应用算法原理。

eb5b30db8b932626.en: TensorFlow is an open-source machine learning framework developed by Google. It provides comprehensive tools and libraries for building and deploying machine learning models across various platforms. The framework supports deep learning, neural networks, and distributed computing. With Python as its primary interface, TensorFlow enables researchers and developers to create scalable ML applications. It includes features for model training, inference, and deployment on multiple devices.
eb5b30db8b932626.zh: TensorFlow是由Google开发的开源机器学习框架，为构建和部署机器学习模型提供全面的工具和库。该框架支持深度学习、神经网络和分布式计算，主要使用Python作为编程接口。TensorFlow使研究人员和开发者能够创建可扩展的机器学习应用程序，包含模型训练、推理和在多种设备上部署的功能。它广泛应用于学术研究和工业实践，支持从移动设备到大型服务器集群的多种部署环境。
eb5b30db8b932626.es: TensorFlow is an open-source machine learning framework developed by Google. It provides comprehensive tools and libraries for building and deploying machine learning models across various platforms. The framework supports deep learning, neural networks, and distributed computing. With Python as its primary interface, TensorFlow enables researchers and developers to create scalable ML applications. It includes features for model training, inference, and deployment on multiple devices.

10ace19f5ad52396.en: The Book of Secret Knowledge is a comprehensive collection of technical resources for IT professionals. It contains curated lists of cheatsheets, manuals, guidelines, and how-to guides covering various domains including DevOps, security, and Linux administration. The repository includes hacking techniques, command-line tools, web utilities, and security research materials. It serves as a reference for system administrators, penetration testers, and security researchers seeking practical technical information.
10ace19f5ad52396.zh: The Book of Secret Knowledge是一个为IT专业人员准备的综合性技术资源集合。它包含精心整理的速查表、手册、指南和操作说明，涵盖DevOps、安全、Linux管理等多个领域。该资源库收录了黑客技术、命令行工具、网络实用程序和安全研究材料，为系统管理员、渗透测试人员和安全研究人员提供实用的技术参考。内容包括各种操作系统的使用技巧、安全配置方法和故障排除指南，是一个不断更新的技术知识库。
10ace19f5ad52396.es: The Book of Secret Knowledge is a comprehensive collection of technical resources for IT professionals. 13a7cace4c1b70b8.en: Oh My Zsh is a community-driven framework for managing Zsh shell configurations, featuring over 2,400 contributors. It provides 300+ plugins for tools like Git, Docker, and programming languages, plus 140+ themes for terminal customization. The project includes an auto-update tool to maintain current community contributions and enhance shell productivity through extensive plugin and theme options.
13a7cace4c1b70b8.zh: Oh My Zsh 是一个社区驱动的 Zsh  shell 配置管理框架，拥有超过 2,400 名贡献者。它提供 300 多个插件，支持 Git、Docker 及多种编程语言工具，还有 140 多个主题用于终端个性化。项目包含自动更新工具，便于同步社区最新内容，通过丰富的插件和主题选项提升 shell 使用效率。
13a7cace4c1b70b8.es: Oh My Zsh is a community-driven framework for managing Zsh shell configurations, featuring over 2,400 contributors. It provides 300+ plugins for tools like Git, Docker, and programming languages, plus 140+ themes for terminal customization. The project includes an auto-update tool to maintain current community contributions and enhance shell productivity through extensive plugin and theme options.

c8676ccfe4d0c350.en: Visual Studio Code is a source code editor developed by Microsoft, built with Electron and TypeScript. It supports multiple programming languages through extensions and provides features like debugging, syntax highlighting, and integrated terminal. The editor is open-source and widely used for software development across various platforms.
c8676ccfe4d0c350.zh: Visual Studio Code 是微软开发的源代码编辑器，基于 Electron 和 TypeScript 构建。它通过扩展支持多种编程语言，提供调试、语法高亮和集成终端等功能。该编辑器是开源的，广泛应用于跨平台软件开发。
c8676ccfe4d0c350.es: Visual Studio Code is a source code editor developed by Microsoft, built with Electron and TypeScript. It supports multiple programming languages through extensions and provides features like debugging, syntax highlighting, and integrated terminal. The editor is open-source and widely used for software development across various platforms.

529627193e620f8e.en: Bootstrap is an open-source front-end framework for developing responsive, mobile-first websites. It provides HTML, CSS, and JavaScript components for building web interfaces, including grid systems, navigation bars, buttons, and forms. The framework uses Sass for CSS preprocessing and supports cross-browser compatibility. Bootstrap helps developers create consistent, professional-looking web applications quickly by offering pre-designed UI elements and responsive layout tools.
529627193e620f8e.zh: Bootstrap 是一个开源的前端框架，用于开发响应式、移动优先的网站项目。它提供 HTML、CSS 和 JavaScript 组件，包括网格系统、导航栏、按钮和表单等界面元素。该框架使用 Sass 进行 CSS 预处理，支持跨浏览器兼容性。Bootstrap 通过提供预设计的用户界面组件和响应式布局工具，帮助开发者快速构建一致且专业的 Web 应用程序，适用于各种屏幕尺寸和设备类型。
529627193e620f8e.es: Bootstrap is an open-source front-end framework for developing responsive, mobile-first websites. It provides HTML, CSS, and JavaScript components for building web interfaces, including grid systems, navigation bars, buttons, and forms. The framework uses Sass for CSS preprocessing and supports cross-browser compatibility. Bootstrap helps developers create consistent, professional-looking web applications quickly by offering pre-designed UI elements and responsive layout tools.

962119a3868b2c05.en: Flutter is an open-source UI software development kit created by Google for building natively compiled applications. It enables developers to create cross-platform apps for mobile, web, and desktop from a single codebase using the Dart programming language. Flutter uses Skia for rendering and provides a rich set of pre-designed widgets following Material Design principles. The framework supports hot reload for fast development cycles and delivers high-performance applications with native compilation.
962119a3868b2c05.zh: Flutter 是由 Google 开发的开源用户界面软件开发工具包，用于构建原生编译的应用程序。它允许开发者使用 Dart 编程语言从单一代码库创建跨平台应用，支持移动端、Web 和桌面平台。Flutter 使用 Skia 进行渲染，提供丰富的预设计组件，遵循 Material Design 设计原则。该框架支持热重载功能以实现快速开发周期，并通过原生编译提供高性能的应用程序体验，适用于 Android、iOS、Windows、macOS、Linux 和 Web 等多种平台。
962119a3868b2c05.es: Flutter is an open-source UI software development kit created by Google for building natively compiled applications. It enables developers to create cross-platform apps for mobile, web, and desktop from a single codebase using the Dart programming language. Flutter uses Skia for rendering and provides a rich set of pre-designed widgets following Material Design principles. The framework supports hot reload for fast development cycles and delivers high-performance applications with native compilation.

6f192d9a2b76343e.en: GitHub's gitignore repository provides a comprehensive collection of .gitignore templates for various programming languages, frameworks, and development environments. These templates help developers exclude unnecessary files from version control, such as build artifacts, dependencies, and system-specific files. The project serves as a centralized resource for Git users to quickly configure their repositories with appropriate ignore patterns, improving repository cleanliness and reducing accidental commits of irrelevant files.
6f192d9a2b76343e.zh: GitHub的gitignore仓库是一个全面的.gitignore模板集合，涵盖多种编程语言、框架和开发环境。这些模板帮助开发者从版本控制中排除不必要的文件，如构建产物、依赖项和系统特定文件。该项目作为Git用户的集中资源，可快速配置适当的忽略模式，提高仓库整洁度并减少意外提交无关文件。模板按技术分类组织，支持各种主流编程语言和工具，便于开发者直接使用或作为参考创建自定义忽略规则。
6f192d9a2b76343e.es: GitHub's gitignore repository provides a comprehensive collection of .gitignore templates for various programming languages, frameworks, and development environments. These templates help developers exclude unnecessary files from version control, such as build artifacts, dependencies, and system-specific files. The project serves as a centralized resource for Git users to quickly configure their repositories with appropriate ignore patterns, improving repository cleanliness and reducing accidental commits of irrelevant files.

1e7626f10516802a.en: Stable Diffusion web UI is a browser-based interface for running Stable Diffusion, a deep learning text-to-image model. The project enables users to generate, modify, and upscale images through an accessible web interface without requiring command-line expertise. It supports various features including text-to-image conversion, image-to-image transformation, and image upscaling. The interface is built using Gradio and provides a user-friendly way to interact with Stable Diffusion models for AI art creation and image generation tasks.
1e7626f10516802a.zh: Stable Diffusion web UI是一个基于浏览器的界面，用于运行Stable Diffusion深度学习文本到图像模型。该项目使用户能够通过可访问的网页界面生成、修改和放大图像，无需命令行专业知识。它支持多种功能，包括文本到图像转换、图像到图像变换以及图像放大。该界面使用GradIO构建，为AI艺术创作和图像生成任务提供了用户友好的Stable Diffusion模型交互方式。项目包含丰富的图像处理选项和模型配置设置，便于用户自定义生成参数和输出效果。
1e7626f10516802a.es: Stable Diffusion web UI is a browser-based interface for running Stable Diffusion, a deep learning text-to-image model. The project enables users to generate, modify, and upscale images through an accessible web interface without requiring command-line expertise. It supports various features including text-to-image conversion, image-to-image transformation, and image upscaling. The interface is built using Gradio and provides a user-friendly way to interact with Stable Diffusion models for AI art creation and image generation tasks.

491beb7c5f97b4c9.en: Awesome-go is a curated collection of notable Go frameworks, libraries, and software projects. It serves as a comprehensive resource for developers working with the Go programming language, organized into categories for easy navigation. The project includes tools for web development, databases, networking, and system administration. Maintained through community contributions, it helps developers discover reliable Go packages and best practices.
491beb7c5f97b4c9.zh: Awesome-go 是一个精心整理的 Go 语言框架、库和软件项目集合。该项目为 Go 开发者提供了全面的资源参考，按照不同类别进行组织，便于查找和使用。收录的内容涵盖网络开发、数据库操作、系统管理和工具开发等多个领域。通过社区贡献维护，帮助开发者发现高质量的 Go 包和最佳实践，提升开发效率。
491beb7c5f97b4c9.es: Awesome-go is a curated collection of notable Go frameworks, libraries, and software projects. It serves as a comprehensive resource for developers working with the Go programming language, organized into categories for easy navigation. The project includes tools for web development, databases, networking, and system administration. Maintained through community contributions, it helps developers discover reliable Go packages and best practices.

412d38ba21b117fd.en: Ollama is a tool that enables users to run various large language models locally, including OpenAI's GPT-OSS, DeepSeek-R1, and Gemma 3. It provides a straightforward way to deploy and interact with these AI models without requiring extensive setup. The platform supports multiple model architectures and formats, making it accessible for developers and researchers to experiment with different language models on their own hardware.
412d38ba21b117fd.zh: Ollama 是一个支持在本地运行多种大型语言模型的工具，包括 OpenAI 的 GPT-OSS、DeepSeek-R1 和 Gemma 3 等。该工具简化了这些 AI 模型的部署和使用过程，用户无需复杂配置即可开始使用。平台兼容多种模型架构和格式，为开发者和研究人员提供了便利，使他们能够在自己的硬件上轻松测试和运行不同的语言模型。
412d38ba21b117fd.es: Ollama is a tool that enables users to run various large language models locally, including OpenAI's GPT-OSS, DeepSeek-R1, and Gemma 3. It provides a straightforward way to deploy and interact with these AI models without requiring extensive setup. The platform supports multiple model architectures and formats, making it accessible for developers and researchers to experiment with different language models on their own hardware.

8c96782f821240cb.en: Transformers is an open-source Python library by Hugging Face providing state-of-the-art machine learning models for text, vision, audio, and multimodal tasks. It supports both training and inference with extensive pretrained models accessible through a model hub. The framework integrates with PyTorch and TensorFlow, enabling researchers and developers to implement transformer architectures efficiently across various domains including NLP, computer vision, and speech processing.
8c96782f821240cb.zh: Transformers是由Hugging Face开发的开源Python库，提供用于文本、视觉、音频和多模态任务的先进机器学习模型。该框架支持训练和推理，通过模型中心提供广泛的预训练模型访问。它与PyTorch和TensorFlow集成，使研究人员和开发者能够高效地在自然语言处理、计算机视觉和语音处理等多个领域实现Transformer架构。该项目在GitHub上拥有超过15万星标，体现了其在AI社区中的广泛采用和影响力。
8c96782f821240cb.es: Transformers is an open-source Python library by Hugging Face providing state-of-the-art machine learning models for text, vision, audio, and multimodal tasks. It supports both training and inference with extensive pretrained models accessible through a model hub. The framework integrates with PyTorch and TensorFlow, enabling researchers and developers to implement transformer architectures efficiently across various domains including NLP, computer vision, and speech processing.

a3ce9ac33dd02a77.en: Microsoft Activation Scripts is an open-source PowerShell-based tool for activating Windows and Microsoft Office products. It implements multiple activation methods including HWID, Ohook, TSforge, KMS38, and Online KMS. The project provides automated activation capabilities along with troubleshooting features for various Windows versions from Windows 10 to Windows 11 and Office suites including Microsoft 365.
a3ce9ac33dd02a77.zh: Microsoft Activation Scripts是一个基于PowerShell的开源工具，用于激活Windows和Microsoft Office产品。它实现了多种激活方法，包括HWID、Ohook、TSforge、KMS38和在线KMS激活。该项目提供自动化激活功能以及针对各种Windows版本（从Windows 10到Windows 11）和Office套件（包括Microsoft 365）的故障排除功能。该工具在GitHub上获得了大量关注，拥有超过15万星标。

The project provides automated activation capabilities along with troubleshooting features for various Windows versions from Windows 10 to Windows 11 and Office suites including Microsoft 365.

dbe3dd13ff032ad2.en: Airbnb's JavaScript Style Guide provides comprehensive coding standards for JavaScript development. It covers ES2015+ features, naming conventions, and best practices for writing clean, maintainable code. The guide includes specific rules for arrow functions, variable declarations, and code organization. It serves as a reference for teams to enforce consistent coding styles across JavaScript projects, helping improve code quality and readability through standardized approaches to common programming patterns and language features.
dbe3dd13ff032ad2.zh: Airbnb的JavaScript风格指南为JavaScript开发提供了全面的编码标准。该指南涵盖了ES2015+特性、命名约定和编写清晰可维护代码的最佳实践。它包含箭头函数、变量声明和代码组织的具体规则。该指南作为团队在JavaScript项目中强制执行一致编码风格的参考，通过标准化常见编程模式和语言特性的方法，帮助提高代码质量和可读性。该资源被广泛采用，有助于开发团队建立统一的编码规范。

d2bba1948a0335c8.en: youtube-dl is a command-line program that enables downloading videos from YouTube and numerous other video hosting platforms. It supports various formats and quality options, allowing users to save videos locally for offline viewing. The tool is written in Python and runs on multiple operating systems including Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides extensive compatibility with different video sites beyond YouTube, making it a versatile solution for video downloading needs through simple command-line interface commands.
d2bba1948a0335c8.zh: youtube-dl是一个命令行程序，能够从YouTube和许多其他视频托管平台下载视频。它支持多种格式和质量选项，允许用户将视频保存到本地进行离线观看。该工具使用Python编写，可在包括Windows、macOS和Linux在内的多个操作系统上运行。除了YouTube之外，它还提供与不同视频网站的广泛兼容性，通过简单的命令行界面命令，使其成为满足视频下载需求的通用解决方案。该程序具有强大的功能，能够处理各种视频源和格式要求。

The tool is written in Python and runs on multiple operating systems including Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides extensive compatibility with different video sites beyond YouTube, making it a versatile solution for video downloading needs through simple command-line interface commands.

87c9da556ea1a3bc.en: Next.js is a React-based framework for building web applications. It supports server-side rendering, static site generation, and hybrid rendering approaches. The framework provides built-in features like automatic code splitting, optimized performance, and simplified deployment. It enables developers to create universal applications that run on both client and server environments. Next.js is maintained by Vercel and widely used for production-ready React applications with enhanced SEO capabilities.

The repository contains various prompt examples designed to help users interact more effectively with AI assistants. It covers multiple use cases including creative writing, technical assistance, and conversational scenarios. The project serves as a resource for improving prompt engineering skills and maximizing the utility of language model tools.

b3b9a8a5dc2ab6e2.en: Tech Interview Handbook is a comprehensive collection of coding interview preparation materials designed for software engineers. It covers algorithms, data structures, system design, and behavioral interview questions. The repository provides practical coding exercises, interview tips, and study guides to help candidates prepare for technical interviews at major tech companies. With over 130,000 stars, it's one of the most popular interview preparation resources on GitHub.

7ec84381ee54f8a4.en: Go is an open-source programming language developed at Google. It is statically typed, compiled, and designed for building simple, reliable, and efficient software. Go features garbage collection, structural typing, and CSP-style concurrency. The language emphasizes simplicity, readability, and performance, making it suitable for system programming, web development, and distributed systems. The repository contains the official Go compiler, tools, and standard library implementation.
7ec84381ee54f8a4.zh: Go是由Google开发的开源编程语言，采用静态类型和编译方式，专为构建简单、可靠且高效的软件而设计。该语言具有垃圾回收、结构类型和CSP风格的并发特性。Go强调简洁性、可读性和性能，适用于系统编程、Web开发和分布式系统。该项目包含官方的Go编译器、工具链和标准库实现，支持跨平台开发并提供了丰富的内置包和并发原语。

d02ac5b7f67b6f45.en: scrcpy is an open-source application for displaying and controlling Android devices from a computer. It streams the device screen via USB or TCP/IP, supporting Android 5.0 and above. The tool uses C, FFmpeg, libav, and SDL2 for efficient video encoding and display. It allows screen mirroring, recording, and device control without requiring root access. The project is developed by Genymobile and has over 129,000 GitHub stars.
d02ac5b7f67b6f45.zh: scrcpy 是一款开源应用程序，用于在计算机上显示和控制安卓设备。它通过 USB 或 TCP/IP 流式传输设备屏幕，支持安卓 5.0 及以上版本。该工具使用 C、FFmpeg、libav 和 SDL2 实现高效的视频编码和显示。它允许屏幕镜像、录制和设备控制，无需 root 权限。该项目由 Genymobile 开发，在 GitHub 上拥有超过 129,000 个星标。

1f43ae24a9e99152.en: yt-dlp is a command-line audio/video downloader written in Python, based on youtube-dl. It supports downloading from numerous sites including YouTube, with features like sponsor block integration and format selection. The tool is actively maintained and includes improvements over its predecessor. It handles various media formats and provides extensive customization options for downloads. 23dbadf90989d55f.en: 30 Seconds of Code is an educational GitHub repository offering concise JavaScript code snippets and programming articles. It covers various web development topics including ES6 JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Node.js, and Git. The project serves as a learning resource with practical examples to help developers improve their coding skills through short, focused examples. With over 125,000 stars, it has become a popular resource for programmers seeking quick reference material and coding techniques.

8c7342674fe7cf2f.en: Langflow is an open-source tool for creating and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows. Built on React Flow, it enables visual development of applications using large language models and generative AI. The platform supports multi-agent systems and provides capabilities for building ChatGPT-like applications. With substantial GitHub popularity, it offers developers a graphical interface to design, test, and implement AI workflows without extensive coding requirements.
8c7342674fe7cf2f.zh: Langflow 是一个用于创建和部署 AI 驱动代理与工作流程的开源工具。基于 React Flow 构建，它支持使用大型语言模型和生成式 AI 进行应用程序的可视化开发。该平台支持多代理系统，并提供构建类似 ChatGPT 应用的能力。凭借在 GitHub 上的广泛流行，它为开发者提供了图形界面来设计、测试和实施 AI 工作流程，无需大量编码要求，简化了 AI 应用的开发过程。

cf9f3eba4c636329.en: React Native is an open-source framework developed by Facebook for building native mobile applications using React. It enables developers to create apps for both iOS and Android platforms using JavaScript and React principles. The framework provides access to native platform APIs and components, allowing for performance close to native applications while maintaining a single codebase. React Native has gained widespread adoption in the mobile development community.
cf9f3eba4c636329.zh: React Native 是由 Facebook 开发的开源框架，用于使用 React 构建原生移动应用程序。该框架允许开发者使用 JavaScript 和 React 原则为 iOS 和 Android 平台创建应用。它提供对原生平台 API 和组件的访问，在保持单一代码库的同时实现接近原生应用的性能。React Native 支持热重载功能，便于快速开发迭代。该框架在移动开发社区中得到广泛采用，拥有活跃的开发者生态系统和丰富的第三方库支持。
cf9f3eba4c636329.es: React Native is an open-source framework developed by Facebook for building native mobile applications using React. It enables developers to create apps for both iOS and Android platforms using JavaScript and React principles. The framework provides access to native platform APIs and components, allowing for performance close to native applications while maintaining a single codebase. React Native has gained widespread adoption in the mobile development community.

fb83dc8ae2d2198c.en: Microsoft PowerToys is an open-source collection of utilities designed to enhance Windows functionality and improve productivity. It includes various tools such as FancyZones for window management, Color Picker for color selection, PowerRename for batch file renaming, and Keyboard Manager for key remapping. These utilities help users customize their Windows experience and automate common tasks. The project is actively maintained by Microsoft and supports both Windows 10 and Windows 11 operating systems.
fb83dc8ae2d2198c.zh: Microsoft PowerToys 是一个开源工具集合，旨在增强 Windows 功能并提高工作效率。该集合包含多种实用工具，包括用于窗口管理的 FancyZones、用于颜色选择的 Color Picker、用于批量文件重命名的 PowerRename 以及用于键盘重映射的 Keyboard Manager。这些工具帮助用户自定义 Windows 体验并自动化常见任务。项目由微软积极维护，支持 Windows 10 和 Windows 11 操作系统。PowerToys 还包含其他实用功能如命令面板、图像大小调整器和文件资源管理器加载项，为高级用户提供更多系统定制选项。
fb83dc8ae2d2198c.es: Microsoft PowerToys is an open-source collection of utilities designed to enhance Windows functionality and improve productivity. It includes various tools such as FancyZones for window management, Color Picker for color selection, PowerRename for batch file renaming, and Keyboard Manager for key remapping. These utilities help users customize their Windows experience and automate common tasks. The project is actively maintained by Microsoft and supports both Windows 10 and Windows 11 operating systems.

cbdb48333f32f319.en: Electron is an open-source framework for building cross-platform desktop applications using web technologies. Its core capability enables developers to create native desktop apps for Windows, macOS, and Linux using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Key strengths include leveraging existing web development skills, extensive Node.js integration, and Chromium's rendering engine for consistent performance. Typical use cases include desktop versions of web applications, development tools, and productivity software. Major applications built with Electron include Visual Studio Code, Slack, and Discord, demonstrating its versatility across different application domains.
cbdb48333f32f319.zh: Electron是一个开源框架，用于使用Web技术构建跨平台桌面应用程序。其核心能力是让开发者能够使用JavaScript、HTML和CSS为Windows、macOS和Linux创建原生桌面应用。主要优势包括利用现有的Web开发技能、深度集成Node.js功能以及采用Chromium渲染引擎确保一致性能。典型应用场景包括Web应用的桌面版本、开发工具和生产力软件。使用Electron构建的知名应用包括Visual Studio Code、Slack和Discord，展示了该框架在不同应用领域的广泛适用性。该框架由GitHub开发维护，支持现代Web标准并提供了丰富的原生API访问能力。
cbdb48333f32f319.es: Electron is an open-source framework for building cross-platform desktop applications using web technologies. Its core capability enables developers to create native desktop apps for Windows, macOS, and Linux using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Key strengths include leveraging existing web development skills, extensive Node.js integration, and Chromium's rendering engine for consistent performance. Typical use cases include desktop versions of web applications, development tools, and productivity software. Major applications built with Electron include Visual Studio Code, Slack, and Discord, demonstrating its versatility across different application domains.

10fb57ebef06739b.en: Kubernetes is an open-source container orchestration platform designed for automating deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications. Its core capabilities include automated scheduling, self-healing through automatic container replacement, horizontal scaling, service discovery, load balancing, and rolling updates. Key strengths are its production-grade reliability, extensive ecosystem, and declarative configuration model. Typical use cases include microservices architectures, batch processing workloads, hybrid cloud deployments, and continuous deployment pipelines across distributed systems.
10fb57ebef06739b.zh: Kubernetes是一个开源容器编排平台，专为自动化部署、扩展和管理容器化应用而设计。其核心功能包括自动化调度、通过自动容器替换实现自我修复、水平扩展、服务发现、负载均衡以及滚动更新。主要优势在于生产级可靠性、庞大生态系统和声明式配置模型。典型应用场景涵盖微服务架构、批处理工作负载、混合云部署以及跨分布式系统的持续部署流水线。该平台由CNCF托管，采用Go语言开发，已成为容器编排领域的事实标准。
10fb57ebef06739b.es: Kubernetes is an open-source container orchestration platform designed for automating deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications. Its core capabilities include automated scheduling, self-healing through automatic container replacement, horizontal scaling, service discovery, load balancing, and rolling updates. Key strengths are its production-grade reliability, extensive ecosystem, and declarative configuration model. Typical use cases include microservices architectures, batch processing workloads, hybrid cloud deployments, and continuous deployment pipelines across distributed systems.

fe09611709ed8a76.en: LangChain is an open-source Python framework for developing context-aware reasoning applications using large language models. It provides tools to build applications that can reason about context and maintain state across interactions. The framework supports integration with multiple AI providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini. It enables developers to create sophisticated AI applications by chaining together different components and maintaining contextual awareness throughout the application workflow.
fe09611709ed8a76.zh: LangChain 是一个开源的 Python 框架，用于使用大型语言模型开发上下文感知的推理应用程序。它提供工具来构建能够推理上下文并在交互过程中保持状态的应用程序。该框架支持与多个 AI 提供商集成，包括 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Google Gemini。它使开发人员能够通过链接不同组件并在整个应用程序工作流程中保持上下文感知来创建复杂的 AI 应用程序。该项目在 GitHub 上拥有大量关注者，表明其在开发者社区中的广泛采用和实用性。
fe09611709ed8a76.es: LangChain is an open-source Python framework for developing context-aware reasoning applications using large language models. It provides tools to build applications that can reason about context and maintain state across interactions. The framework supports integration with multiple AI providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini. It enables developers to create sophisticated AI applications by chaining together different components and maintaining contextual awareness throughout the application workflow.

c68bc4d1f04b83a2.en: D3 is a JavaScript library for creating dynamic, interactive data visualizations in web browsers. It uses SVG, Canvas, and HTML to bring data to life through custom visual representations. The library provides powerful data-driven transformations of the Document Object Model, enabling developers to bind arbitrary data to DOM elements and apply data-driven transformations. D3 emphasizes web standards and gives users full control over the final visual output, making it suitable for creating complex, custom data visualizations.
c68bc4d1f04b83a2.zh: D3 是一个 JavaScript 库，用于在 Web 浏览器中创建动态、交互式的数据可视化。它使用 SVG、Canvas 和 HTML 通过自定义视觉表示使数据变得生动。该库提供强大的数据驱动的文档对象模型转换，使开发人员能够将任意数据绑定到 DOM 元素并应用数据驱动的转换。D3 强调 Web 标准，并让用户完全控制最终的视觉输出，使其适合创建复杂、自定义的数据可视化。该项目在 GitHub 上拥有极高的关注度，表明其在数据可视化领域的领导地位和广泛采用。
c68bc4d1f04b83a2.es: D3 is a JavaScript library for creating dynamic, interactive data visualizations in web browsers. It uses SVG, Canvas, and HTML to bring data to life through custom visual representations. The library provides powerful data-driven transformations of the Document Object Model, enabling developers to bind arbitrary data to DOM elements and apply data-driven transformations. D3 emphasizes web standards and gives users full control over the final visual output, making it suitable for creating complex, custom data visualizations.

1a39fd33124af5a1.en: Three.js is a JavaScript 3D library that enables creation and display of 3D computer graphics in web browsers. It supports multiple rendering backends including WebGL, WebGPU, SVG, and HTML5 Canvas. The library provides comprehensive tools for 3D scene creation, camera controls, lighting, materials, and animations. It also includes support for virtual reality and augmented reality through WebXR integration.
1a39fd33124af5a1.zh: Three.js 是一个 JavaScript 3D 库，用于在网页浏览器中创建和显示三维计算机图形。该库支持多种渲染后端，包括 WebGL、WebGPU、SVG 和 HTML5 Canvas。它提供完整的工具集用于构建 3D 场景、相机控制、光照系统、材质和动画效果。Three.js 还通过 WebXR 集成支持虚拟现实和增强现实应用开发，使得开发者能够创建交互式的 3D 体验。
1a39fd33124af5a1.es: Three.js is a JavaScript 3D library that enables creation and display of 3D computer graphics in web browsers. It supports multiple rendering backends including WebGL, WebGPU, SVG, and HTML5 Canvas. The library provides comprehensive tools for 3D scene creation, camera controls, lighting, materials, and animations. It also includes support for virtual reality and augmented reality through WebXR integration.

c948f7f94ee753a9.en: Axios is a promise-based HTTP client for JavaScript that works in both browser and Node.js environments. It provides a simple API for making HTTP requests and handling responses. The library supports all modern HTTP methods and includes features like request/response interception, automatic JSON data transformation, and client-side protection against XSRF. It handles request cancellation and provides built-in support for upload progress tracking.
c948f7f94ee753a9.zh: Axios 是一个基于 Promise 的 HTTP 客户端库，适用于浏览器和 Node.js 环境。它提供了简洁的 API 用于发送 HTTP 请求和处理响应。该库支持所有现代 HTTP 方法，并包含请求/响应拦截、自动 JSON 数据转换、客户端 XSRF 防护等功能。Axios 能够处理请求取消操作，并内置支持上传进度跟踪，使得网络请求管理更加便捷可靠。
c948f7f94ee753a9.es: Axios is a promise-based HTTP client for JavaScript that works in both browser and Node.js environments. It provides a simple API for making HTTP requests and handling responses. The library supports all modern HTTP methods and includes features like request/response interception, automatic JSON data transformation, and client-side protection against XSRF. It handles request cancellation and provides built-in support for upload progress tracking.

b9fa4253a11f507a.en: Excalidraw is an open-source virtual whiteboard application designed for creating hand-drawn style diagrams. It provides a collaborative canvas environment where multiple users can sketch together in real-time. The tool supports various drawing elements and is optimized for diagram creation with a focus on simplicity and ease of use. It's particularly useful for technical diagrams, flowcharts, and brainstorming sessions.
b9fa4253a11f507a.zh: Excalidraw 是一个开源的虚拟白板应用程序，专门用于创建手绘风格的图表。它提供了一个协作画布环境，多个用户可以实时一起绘制草图。该工具支持各种绘图元素，并针对图表创建进行了优化，注重简单性和易用性。它特别适用于技术图表、流程图和头脑风暴会议，具有直观的界面和基本的绘图功能。

ddeb57353cbb79ce.en: TypeScript is a programming language developed by Microsoft that extends JavaScript by adding static type definitions. It compiles to plain JavaScript and provides optional type checking, enabling developers to catch errors during development rather than at runtime. TypeScript supports modern JavaScript features while adding interfaces, generics, and other type-related capabilities to improve code quality and maintainability in large-scale applications.
ddeb57353cbb79ce.zh: TypeScript 是由微软开发的编程语言，通过添加静态类型定义来扩展 JavaScript。它编译为纯 JavaScript 并提供可选的类型检查，使开发人员能够在开发期间而不是运行时捕获错误。TypeScript 支持现代 JavaScript 特性，同时添加了接口、泛型和其他与类型相关的功能，以提高大型应用程序中的代码质量和可维护性。该语言与现有 JavaScript 代码库完全兼容。
ddeb57353cbb79ce.es: TypeScript is a programming language developed by Microsoft that extends JavaScript by adding static type definitions. It compiles to plain JavaScript and provides optional type checking, enabling developers to catch errors during development rather than at runtime. TypeScript supports modern JavaScript features while adding interfaces, generics, and other type-related capabilities to improve code quality and maintainability in large-scale applications.

32520056c898f1b2.en: Deno is a modern runtime environment for JavaScript and TypeScript, developed using Rust. It provides secure execution by default with no file, network, or environment access unless explicitly enabled. Deno includes built-in TypeScript support without requiring additional configuration and features a standard library for common tasks. The runtime supports ES modules natively and includes a built-in package manager, eliminating the need for a separate package.json file.
32520056c898f1b2.zh: Deno 是一个使用 Rust 开发的现代 JavaScript 和 TypeScript 运行时环境。它默认提供安全执行，除非明确启用，否则不允许文件、网络或环境访问。Deno 内置 TypeScript 支持，无需额外配置，并包含用于常见任务的标准库。该运行时原生支持 ES 模块，并内置包管理器，无需单独的 package.json 文件。Deno 旨在解决 Node.js 的一些设计问题，提供更安全的默认设置和现代化的开发体验。
32520056c898f1b2.es: Deno is a modern runtime environment for JavaScript and TypeScript, developed using Rust. It provides secure execution by default with no file, network, or environment access unless explicitly enabled. Deno includes built-in TypeScript support without requiring additional configuration and features a standard library for common tasks. 98bce6fb5b675ed4.en: Node.js Best Practices is a comprehensive collection of guidelines and recommendations for Node.js development, updated to July 2024. It covers various aspects including project structure, error handling, testing strategies, security considerations, and performance optimization. The repository provides practical examples and explanations for implementing best practices in real-world applications. It serves as an educational resource for developers working with Node.js across different domains including REST APIs, microservices, and general application development.

afab76ac8ef96e4f.en: Create React App is a command-line tool from Facebook that sets up a modern React web application with a single command. It provides a pre-configured build environment with no need for complex setup. The tool includes development server, build optimization, and testing utilities. It supports the latest JavaScript features and CSS processing. Users can start developing immediately without configuring build tools like Webpack or Babel manually.

8c040991f5ca97c4.en: Godot Engine is an open-source, cross-platform game engine for developing 2D and 3D games. It features a scene-based architecture and visual editor. The engine supports multiple programming languages including GDScript, C#, and C++. It includes tools for animation, physics, rendering, and audio. Godot can export games to various platforms including Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and web browsers. The engine is completely free with no royalties or subscription fees.

Key strengths include its completely free service model, open-source transparency, and user-friendly interface. 5b93a31157f0e201.en: DeepSeek-V3 is an open-source large language model developed by DeepSeek AI. The project is hosted on GitHub with significant community engagement, evidenced by over 99,000 stars and 16,000 forks. As a language model, it's designed for natural language processing tasks including text generation, understanding, and reasoning. The repository provides access to model weights, inference code, and documentation for researchers and developers to utilize and build upon the technology.

b87110a3a23f583e.en: Microsoft's Generative AI for Beginners is an educational GitHub repository offering 21 lessons on building with generative AI technologies. The curriculum covers fundamental concepts including language models, prompt engineering, semantic search, and transformer architectures. It integrates with Microsoft Azure services and references technologies like ChatGPT, DALL-E, and GPT models. The project provides practical learning materials for developers new to generative AI, with comprehensive documentation and code examples.

dae4708c87f203c2.en: frp is a fast reverse proxy written in Go that enables exposing local servers behind NAT or firewalls to the internet. It supports various protocols including HTTP, TCP, and UDP, facilitating secure tunneling for remote access. The tool helps bypass network restrictions and allows external connectivity to internal services. It features simple configuration and can operate in client-server mode for reliable connections across restricted networks.
dae4708c87f203c2.zh: frp 是一个用 Go 语言编写的快速反向代理工具，主要用于帮助用户将位于 NAT 或防火墙后的本地服务器暴露到互联网。它支持 HTTP、TCP、UDP 等多种协议，能够建立安全隧道实现远程访问。该工具可以绕过网络限制，使外部能够连接到内部服务。采用客户端-服务器模式运行，配置简单，能够在受限制的网络环境中提供可靠的连接服务。

It features simple configuration and can operate in client-server mode for reliable connections across restricted networks.

5c1739400ad79bff.en: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application built with Rust, designed as a self-hosted alternative to commercial solutions like TeamViewer. It supports cross-platform operation including Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android. The software enables remote control, file transfer, and supports both RDP and VNC protocols. It can be deployed on personal servers for enhanced privacy and security, offering P2P connectivity options.
5c1739400ad79bff.zh: RustDesk 是一个用 Rust 语言开发的开源远程桌面应用程序，旨在作为 TeamViewer 等商业解决方案的自托管替代品。它支持跨平台运行，包括 Windows、macOS、Linux、iOS 和 Android。该软件提供远程控制、文件传输功能，并支持 RDP 和 VNC 协议。用户可以将其部署在个人服务器上以增强隐私和安全性，同时提供点对点连接选项，实现高效的远程访问管理。

It supports cross-platform operation including Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android. The software enables remote control, file transfer, and supports both RDP and VNC protocols. It can be deployed on personal servers for enhanced privacy and security, offering P2P connectivity options.

b951b01f644f95c0.en: Angular is an open-source web application framework developed by Google. It uses TypeScript as its primary programming language and enables developers to build dynamic single-page applications. The framework provides tools for routing, forms management, client-server communication, and dependency injection. Angular supports Progressive Web App (PWA) development and focuses on performance optimization for modern web applications. It includes a comprehensive set of libraries and follows component-based architecture patterns.

fcca460af844f382.en: This GitHub project provides a comprehensive collection of publicly available IPTV channels from around the world. c39b685d954a2003.en: Tauri is a framework for building desktop and mobile applications using web technologies. It enables developers to create smaller, faster, and more secure native applications by combining a web frontend with Rust backend. The framework supports both desktop and mobile platforms, leveraging webview components for rendering while maintaining native performance and security benefits. It provides an alternative to traditional electron-based applications.
c39b685d954a2003.zh: Tauri是一个使用Web技术构建桌面和移动应用程序的框架。它允许开发者通过将Web前端与Rust后端相结合，创建更小、更快、更安全的原生应用程序。该框架支持桌面和移动平台，利用Webview组件进行渲染，同时保持原生性能和安全性优势。Tauri为开发者提供了传统基于Electron的应用程序的替代方案，特别注重应用程序的尺寸优化和安全性改进。

a6b604b218a53f0a.en: Material UI is a comprehensive React component library that implements Google's Material Design system. It provides a complete set of customizable UI components for building modern web applications. The project is open source and free to use permanently. With extensive documentation and over 96,000 GitHub stars, it has become a popular choice for enterprise-level React development projects requiring robust UI solutions.

c3698fc08f44532f.en: shadcn/ui is an open-source collection of UI components designed for accessibility and visual appeal. Built with React, Next.js, Radix UI, and Tailwind CSS, it provides reusable interface elements that integrate with popular web frameworks. The project emphasizes clean code distribution and developer-friendly implementation while maintaining open-source principles. It serves as a component library platform rather than a traditional npm package.
c3698fc08f44532f.zh: shadcn/ui 是一个开源的用户界面组件集合，专注于可访问性和美观设计。该项目基于 React、Next.js、Radix UI 和 Tailwind CSS 构建，提供可复用的界面元素，能够与主流网页框架集成。它强调清晰的代码分发和开发者友好的实现方式，同时遵循开源原则。该库作为组件平台运作，而非传统的 npm 包分发模式，允许开发者直接使用和修改组件代码。

426458ec2cb83d23.en: HowToCook is a comprehensive cooking guide specifically created for programmers, containing detailed recipes and cooking methods for home preparation. The project focuses on Chinese cuisine and provides step-by-step instructions in Simplified Chinese. It serves as a practical resource for learning cooking techniques, with content organized systematically similar to technical documentation. The repository functions as a community-maintained cookbook with extensive recipe coverage.
426458ec2cb83d23.zh: HowToCook 是一个专门为程序员设计的综合性烹饪指南，包含详细的家庭烹饪食谱和方法说明。该项目专注于中华美食，提供简体中文的逐步烹饪指导。它作为学习烹饪技巧的实用资源，内容组织方式类似于技术文档的系统性结构。该仓库作为社区维护的食谱集合，涵盖了广泛的菜肴类型和烹饪技术，帮助用户从基础到进阶掌握厨房技能。

57ec25c255ed3f37.en: This GitHub repository is a comprehensive collection of technical knowledge essential for software developers. It covers fundamental computer science concepts, programming principles, and development practices. The project serves as an educational resource for both novice and experienced programmers, organized as a curated list of important topics. Content is licensed under Creative Commons and includes various aspects of software engineering and computer science fundamentals that developers should understand.
57ec25c255ed3f37.zh: 该项目是一个GitHub知识库，汇集了软件开发人员应掌握的技术知识集合。内容涵盖计算机科学基础概念、编程原则和开发实践，作为面向初学者和经验丰富程序员的综合性教育资源。项目采用知识共享许可协议，以精心整理的清单形式呈现软件工程各个领域的重要主题，包括算法、数据结构、系统设计、网络协议等核心计算机科学内容，为开发者提供全面的学习参考。

The project serves as an educational resource for both novice and experienced programmers, organized as a curated list of important topics. 2eab037a0c32ba81.en: Puppeteer is a Node.js library that provides a high-level API for controlling headless Chrome and Firefox browsers. It enables automated browser interactions including page navigation, form submission, screenshot capture, and PDF generation. Developers use it for testing web applications, scraping website content, and automating repetitive browser tasks. The tool supports modern web features and can simulate user interactions, making it valuable for web development workflows and quality assurance processes.
2eab037a0c32ba81.zh: Puppeteer是一个Node.js库，提供用于控制无头Chrome和Firefox浏览器的高级API。它支持自动化浏览器操作，包括页面导航、表单提交、屏幕截图捕获和PDF生成。开发者主要将其用于Web应用程序测试、网站内容抓取以及重复性浏览器任务的自动化。该工具支持现代Web特性，能够模拟用户交互行为，在Web开发工作流程和质量保证过程中发挥重要作用，为前端开发和测试提供强大的自动化能力。
2eab037a0c32ba81.es: Puppeteer is a Node.js library that provides a high-level API for controlling headless Chrome and Firefox browsers. It enables automated browser interactions including page navigation, form submission, screenshot capture, and PDF generation. Developers use it for testing web applications, scraping website content, and automating repetitive browser tasks. The tool supports modern web features and can simulate user interactions, making it valuable for web development workflows and quality assurance processes.

47f5379708a0bf00.en: Microsoft's Web-Dev-For-Beginners is a comprehensive 24-lesson curriculum designed to teach web development fundamentals over 12 weeks. The project covers essential web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript through structured educational content. It provides beginner-friendly tutorials and learning materials for those starting their web development journey. The curriculum is organized into progressive lessons that build foundational skills in front-end web development.
47f5379708a0bf00.zh: 微软的Web-Dev-For-Beginners是一个全面的24课课程，旨在通过12周时间教授Web开发基础知识。该项目通过结构化的教育内容涵盖HTML、CSS和JavaScript等基本Web技术。它为初学者提供友好的教程和学习材料，帮助开启Web开发之旅。课程按渐进式课程组织，逐步建立前端Web开发的基础技能。该项目采用系统化的教学方法，确保学习者能够循序渐进地掌握核心概念和实践技能。
47f5379708a0bf00.es: Microsoft's Web-Dev-For-Beginners is a comprehensive 24-lesson curriculum designed to teach web development fundamentals over 12 weeks. The project covers essential web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript through structured educational content. It provides beginner-friendly tutorials and learning materials for those starting their web development journey. The curriculum is organized into progressive lessons that build foundational skills in front-end web development.

6feed1347d26f516.en: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework that enables rapid user interface development. It provides low-level utility classes for building custom designs without writing custom CSS. The framework integrates with PostCSS and focuses on responsive design capabilities. Developers can create responsive layouts and components efficiently using predefined utility classes. This approach promotes faster development cycles and maintainable code structure for web applications.
6feed1347d26f516.zh: Tailwind CSS是一个实用程序优先的CSS框架，支持快速用户界面开发。它提供低级别的实用程序类，无需编写自定义CSS即可构建定制设计。该框架与PostCSS集成，专注于响应式设计功能。开发人员可以使用预定义的实用程序类高效创建响应式布局和组件。这种方法促进了更快的开发周期和可维护的代码结构，特别适合现代Web应用程序开发。该框架强调功能性和效率，通过组合小型、单一用途的类来实现复杂的设计需求。
6feed1347d26f516.es: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework that enables rapid user interface development. It provides low-level utility classes for building custom designs without writing custom CSS. The framework integrates with PostCSS and focuses on responsive design capabilities. Developers can create responsive layouts and components efficiently using predefined utility classes. This approach promotes faster development cycles and maintainable code structure for web applications.

423210872945d014.en: Vue Element Admin is a comprehensive admin dashboard template built with Vue.js and Element UI. It provides a complete front-end solution for management systems with features like i18n internationalization, mock data support, and integration with libraries like Axios, Vuex, and TinyMCE. The project includes built-in support for Excel export, Webpack 4 configuration, and offers a production-ready admin interface framework for web applications.
423210872945d014.zh: Vue Element Admin 是一个基于 Vue.js 和 Element UI 构建的完整后台管理系统前端解决方案。该项目提供了丰富的管理后台功能，包括国际化支持、模拟数据、权限验证和多种组件集成。系统采用 Vue CLI 搭建，支持 Webpack 4 构建，集成了 Axios、Vuex、TinyMCE 富文本编辑器等常用库，并提供了 Excel 导出等实用功能，可作为企业级管理系统的前端基础框架使用。
423210872945d014.es: Vue Element Admin is a comprehensive admin dashboard template built with Vue.js and Element UI. It provides a complete front-end solution for management systems with features like i18n internationalization, mock data support, and integration with libraries like Axios, Vuex, and TinyMCE. The project includes built-in support for Excel export, Webpack 4 configuration, and offers a production-ready admin interface framework for web applications.

15e22ebac0a63468.en: FastAPI is a modern, high-performance web framework for building APIs with Python 3.6+. It leverages standard Python type hints for automatic data validation, serialization, and documentation generation. The framework supports asynchronous programming, automatically generates OpenAPI and JSON Schema documentation, and includes integrated Swagger UI and ReDoc interfaces. Built on Starlette and Pydantic, it offers fast development and production-ready performance for RESTful APIs.
15e22ebac0a63468.zh: FastAPI 是一个用于构建 API 的现代、高性能 Python Web 框架，基于 Python 3.6+ 的类型提示特性。该框架利用 Python 类型注解自动生成数据验证、序列化和 API 文档，支持异步编程模式。它能够自动创建 OpenAPI 和 JSON Schema 规范文档，并集成 Swagger UI 和 ReDoc 接口文档工具。基于 Starlette 和 Pydantic 构建，具有快速开发和高性能的特点，适用于生产环境的 RESTful API 开发。
15e22ebac0a63468.es: FastAPI is a modern, high-performance web framework for building APIs with Python 3.6+. It leverages standard Python type hints for automatic data validation, serialization, and documentation generation. The framework supports asynchronous programming, automatically generates OpenAPI and JSON Schema documentation, and includes integrated Swagger UI and ReDoc interfaces. Built on Starlette and Pydantic, it offers fast development and production-ready performance for RESTful APIs.

d0d156248890fc2c.en: ComfyUI is a powerful and modular interface for diffusion models, featuring a graph and nodes-based system. It serves as a GUI, API, and backend for stable diffusion applications. Built with Python and PyTorch, it enables users to create and manage complex AI workflows visually. The project is open-source and hosted on GitHub, with significant community engagement through stars and forks.
d0d156248890fc2c.zh: ComfyUI 是一个基于图形和节点界面的强大模块化扩散模型工具，提供 GUI、API 和后端功能。它使用 Python 和 PyTorch 构建，专为稳定扩散应用设计，允许用户通过可视化方式创建和管理复杂的 AI 工作流程。该项目是开源的，在 GitHub 上托管，拥有活跃的社区参与，通过星标和分叉数量体现其受欢迎程度。
d0d156248890fc2c.es: ComfyUI is a powerful and modular interface for diffusion models, featuring a graph and nodes-based system. It serves as a GUI, API, and backend for stable diffusion applications. Built with Python and PyTorch, it enables users to create and manage complex AI workflows visually. The project is open-source and hosted on GitHub, with significant community engagement through stars and forks.

2c368c5af3ef035d.en: Supabase is a development platform centered around PostgreSQL, providing dedicated databases for building web, mobile, and AI applications. It offers features like authentication, real-time capabilities, and vector embeddings through extensions like pgvector. As an open-source alternative to Firebase, it supports various technologies including Next.js and websockets for full-stack development.
2c368c5af3ef035d.zh: Supabase 是一个以 PostgreSQL 为核心的开发平台，为构建 Web、移动和 AI 应用提供专用数据库。它具备认证、实时功能和向量嵌入等特性，通过 pgvector 等扩展支持。作为 Firebase 的开源替代方案，Supabase 兼容多种技术，包括 Next.js 和 WebSocket，适用于全栈开发，并促进社区协作。
2c368c5af3ef035d.es: Supabase is a development platform centered around PostgreSQL, providing dedicated databases for building web, mobile, and AI applications. It offers features like authentication, real-time capabilities, and vector embeddings through extensions like pgvector. As an open-source alternative to Firebase, it supports various technologies including Next.js and websockets for full-stack development.

6bcf74f2d73943d7.en: Awesome-Mac is a comprehensive GitHub repository that curates premium software applications specifically for macOS systems. It has grown significantly from its original concept and now organizes applications across various categories. The project serves as a curated list of desktop applications for Apple's operating system, with substantial community engagement reflected in its GitHub statistics of nearly 89,000 stars and over 6,700 forks.
6bcf74f2d73943d7.zh: Awesome-Mac 是一个 GitHub 上的开源项目，专门收集和整理适用于 macOS 操作系统的优质软件应用程序。该项目已从最初的概念发展壮大，现按不同类别组织各类桌面应用。作为一个精选的应用列表资源，它涵盖了苹果操作系统下的各种软件工具。该项目在 GitHub 上拥有显著的社区关注度，获得了近 8.9 万星标和超过 6700 次分叉，体现了其在 Mac 用户群体中的广泛认可和实用价值。
6bcf74f2d73943d7.es: Awesome-Mac is a comprehensive GitHub repository that curates premium software applications specifically for macOS systems. It has grown significantly from its original concept and now organizes applications across various categories. The project serves as a curated list of desktop applications for Apple's operating system, with substantial community engagement reflected in its GitHub statistics of nearly 89,000 stars and over 6,700 forks.

47365353197be87f.en: Whisper is OpenAI's open-source speech recognition system that achieves robust performance through large-scale weak supervision training. The model demonstrates strong capabilities in transcribing speech across various conditions and languages. Available on GitHub, it has gained significant community traction with approximately 88,800 stars and over 11,000 forks, indicating widespread interest in its advanced speech-to-text technology and potential applications in multilingual transcription tasks.
47365353197be87f.zh: Whisper 是 OpenAI 开发的开源语音识别系统，通过大规模弱监督训练实现了强大的语音转文本性能。该系统能够处理多种语言和不同环境条件下的语音输入，展现出优秀的转录能力。该项目在 GitHub 上公开可用，已获得约 8.88 万星标和超过 1.1 万次分叉，反映了社区对这项先进语音技术的广泛关注。该模型在多语言转录任务中具有重要应用价值，为开发者和研究人员提供了高质量的语音识别解决方案。
47365353197be87f.es: Whisper is OpenAI's open-source speech recognition system that achieves robust performance through large-scale weak supervision training. The model demonstrates strong capabilities in transcribing speech across various conditions and languages. Available on GitHub, it has gained significant community traction with approximately 88,800 stars and over 11,000 forks, indicating widespread interest in its advanced speech-to-text technology and potential applications in multilingual transcription tasks.

1c29c8a01ea7a49f.en: This GitHub repository collects system prompts, internal tools, and AI models from various open-source AI development tools and platforms. It includes resources from Cursor, Devin AI, Replit, VSCode Agent, Windsurf, v0, and numerous other AI coding assistants. The project serves as a comprehensive reference for developers working with AI-powered development environments, providing access to the underlying prompt engineering and model configurations used by these tools.
1c29c8a01ea7a49f.zh: 该GitHub仓库收集了多种开源AI开发工具和平台的系统提示词、内部工具及AI模型。包含来自Cursor、Devin AI、Replit、VSCode Agent、Windsurf、v0等众多AI编程助手的资源。项目为使用AI驱动开发环境的开发者提供全面参考，可访问这些工具使用的底层提示工程和模型配置。该资源库涵盖了当前流行的AI编程助手生态系统，帮助开发者理解和利用这些工具的运作机制。
1c29c8a01ea7a49f.es: This GitHub repository collects system prompts, internal tools, and AI models from various open-source AI development tools and platforms. It includes resources from Cursor, Devin AI, Replit, VSCode Agent, Windsurf, v0, and numerous other AI coding assistants. 44d20926a253df55.en: Storybook is an open-source tool for developing UI components in isolation from the main application. It serves as a workshop environment where developers can build, document, and test individual components without the complexity of the full application context. Supporting multiple frameworks including React, Vue, Angular, and others, it has become an industry standard for component-driven development and design system documentation.
44d20926a253df55.zh: Storybook是一个开源工具，用于在独立于主应用程序的环境中开发UI组件。它作为一个工作坊环境，开发者可以在其中构建、记录和测试单个组件，而无需面对完整应用程序的复杂性。支持包括React、Vue、Angular在内的多种框架，已成为组件驱动开发和设计系统文档的行业标准工具。该工具帮助团队创建可重用的UI组件库，并确保组件在不同环境中的一致性和可靠性。
44d20926a253df55.es: Storybook is an open-source tool for developing UI components in isolation from the main application. It serves as a workshop environment where developers can build, document, and test individual components without the complexity of the full application context. Supporting multiple frameworks including React, Vue, Angular, and others, it has become an industry standard for component-driven development and design system documentation.

9b48d8103bdaf693.en: v2rayN is a GUI client application for Windows, Linux, and macOS that supports multiple proxy protocols including V2Ray, Xray, sing-box, Shadowsocks, Trojan, VMess, and VLESS. It provides SOCKS5 proxy functionality and supports advanced transport layer security features like XTLS. The project serves as a user-friendly interface for configuring and managing proxy connections across different operating systems, enabling users to establish secure network connections through various tunneling protocols.
9b48d8103bdaf693.zh: v2rayN 是一款适用于 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 的图形用户界面客户端应用程序，支持多种代理协议，包括 V2Ray、Xray、sing-box、Shadowsocks、Trojan、VMess 和 VLESS。它提供 SOCKS5 代理功能，并支持高级传输层安全特性，如 XTLS。该项目作为用户友好的界面，用于在不同操作系统上配置和管理代理连接，使用户能够通过各种隧道协议建立安全的网络连接。该工具帮助用户轻松设置和管理复杂的代理配置，无需深入命令行操作。
9b48d8103bdaf693.es: v2rayN is a GUI client application for Windows, Linux, and macOS that supports multiple proxy protocols including V2Ray, Xray, sing-box, Shadowsocks, Trojan, VMess, and VLESS. It provides SOCKS5 proxy functionality and supports advanced transport layer security features like XTLS. The project serves as a user-friendly interface for configuring and managing proxy connections across different operating systems, enabling users to establish secure network connections through various tunneling protocols.

718f7017877663b9.en: nvm is a POSIX-compliant bash script that functions as a Node.js version manager, allowing users to install and manage multiple active Node.js versions simultaneously. It supports both standard Node.js releases and Long-Term Support versions, working across various shell environments including bash and zsh. The tool enables developers to switch between different Node.js versions for different projects using .nvmrc configuration files, facilitating compatibility testing and development workflow management without requiring system-wide Node.js installations.
718f7017877663b9.zh: nvm 是一个符合 POSIX 标准的 bash 脚本，作为 Node.js 版本管理器，允许用户同时安装和管理多个活动的 Node.js 版本。它支持标准 Node.js 发布版和长期支持版本，可在多种 shell 环境中运行，包括 bash 和 zsh。该工具使开发人员能够使用 .nvmrc 配置文件在不同项目之间切换不同的 Node.js 版本，便于兼容性测试和开发工作流程管理，而无需进行系统范围的 Node.js 安装。nvm 简化了 Node.js 版本控制，帮助开发者在不同项目需求下保持环境一致性。
718f7017877663b9.es: nvm is a POSIX-compliant bash script that functions as a Node.js version manager, allowing users to install and manage multiple active Node.js versions simultaneously. It supports both standard Node.js releases and Long-Term Support versions, working across various shell environments including bash and zsh. The tool enables developers to switch between different Node.js versions for different projects using .nvmrc configuration files, facilitating compatibility testing and development workflow management without requiring system-wide Node.js installations.
